newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Taiping says don't know why stock active.
newsitem.headline: Taiping says don't know why stock active.

text.p: Malaysian property developer Taiping Consolidated Bhd said on Monday it cannot explain why its stock rocketed upwards on Monday.
"There is material development in our company's business and affairs which have not been disclosed previously.
"We are not aware of any reasons for the unusual market movement," Taiping said in a statement in reply to a query from the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on the stock's surge.
Taiping stock surged to a 12-month high on Monday in the market's heaviest volume.
The stock jumped 88 cents or 40.37 percent to 3.06 ringgit on volume of 32.3 million.
Dealers said there were rumours that the company may be selling its interest in the Sentul Raya mixed property development project in Kuala Lumpur.
